$comment: AGL-149 follow-up. Reserved canvas regions where a KERNEL-GENERATED figure is composited after the render, instead of being drawn by the image model. Every one of the 20 rejected tranche-1 mockups failed the `mathematical correctness` reject axis; generative image models cannot render mathematically-constrained content, and in AGL the mathematics IS the content. Geometry is FRACTIONAL (0..1 of the rendered image's own width/height) so it survives whatever pixel size the model actually emits. build-prompts.py reads this to reserve the plate in the prompt; composite-figure.sh reads the same entries to place the figure. One file so the two halves cannot drift.

S04.description: Central concentric Euclidean ring stack. The rings, their onset markers, the E(k,n) notation and the gap sequence are all emitted from src/operators/euclidean.ts.
S04.reserveAs: an empty flat recessed panel with its normal border, corner radius and section header, and nothing at all inside it

S07.description: Pulse-field ring for the timeline-focus screen. Onset positions come from src/operators/euclidean.ts, so the rendered onset count cannot contradict the printed ratio -- the tranche-1 defect here was a canvas claiming a 7/12 pulse field while drawing five onsets.
S07.reserveAs: an empty flat canvas panel with its normal border and section header, and nothing at all inside it -- the timeline, ruler and track lanes below it are unaffected and should still be fully designed
